product_summary: Indo-Air Compressors Pvt. Ltd. (Ahmedabad, Gujarat; est. 1977 as compressor-parts maker for OEMs, own 'Indo-Air' brand compressors and vacuum pumps since 1998, range 1–270 HP). Real catalogue per indoair.com: Booster compressors 10–40 HP (IBH series, 7–13 bar inlet up to 40 bar); Rotary screw lubricated 7.5–270 HP; Reciprocating oil-free high-pressure water-cooled 40–215 HP; Oil-free medium-pressure water-cooled 30–215 HP; Reciprocating single-stage low-pressure 1–20 HP; Reciprocating two-stage medium-pressure 2–30 HP; Heavy-duty water-cooled vertical compressors; Oil-free reciprocating compressors; Vacuum pumps; Spare parts; Auxiliary equipment. Served industries listed: construction, manufacturing, agriculture, energy, HVAC, pharma, food & beverage, aerospace, automotive, hospitals, mining, transportation. Source: https://indoair.com/ (home page, product menu and product blocks).
role_hint: manufacturer (own brand, own plant in Ahmedabad, in-house manufacturing/R&D pages; also historically an OEM parts supplier — no trader signs found on the site)
comment: HS mapping: declared 841391 is 'parts of pumps for liquids' (HS 8413.91) — that is a pumps-for-liquids part code and does not correspond to this company's line at all; the correct parts code for air compressors/vacuum pumps is 841490. Declared 841430 is 'compressors for refrigerating equipment' (HS 8414.30) — Indo-Air's catalogue shows general-purpose industrial air compressors and vacuum pumps, not refrigeration compressors, so 8414.30 is not corroborated; the correct heading is 841480 (plus 841410 for vacuum pumps). Net effect: both declared codes are wrong for the actual product mix; the company is kept in the base and the codes are corrected to 841480 / 841410 / 841490 (verdict accepted_hs_corrected per Rule 3 — HS mismatch is not a rejection ground). Industry misclassification: declared industry 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy & mining) is wrong — the company is a general industrial machinery maker (HS ch. 84, compressors/vacuum pumps); mining is only one of many end-user industries listed on the site, not its own sector. Product lines missing from the declaration: vacuum pumps (841410), spare parts/compressor components (841490), booster compressors and oil-free high-pressure ranges (all 841480), auxiliary equipment. Trader signs: none observed — manufacturer. All product claims above are from the company's own website and are therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line was available in this task to corroborate any specific HS-6 code or shipment; no registry, revenue or customs-volume research was performed (out of scope). Note: the batch label 'Pumps' is a misnomer for this entity — it makes compressors and vacuum pumps, not liquid pumps.
